narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Corners of fields are square, so the fourth angle is ninety degrees.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Then the four angles would add up to three hundred seventy degrees.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Nothing tells us this corner is square, so we must work it out.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows a square corner mark at D; the sum 75 + 95 + 110 + 90 = 370 appears under it; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>The four angles of any quadrilateral add up to three hundred sixty degrees.
<bookmark mark='two'/>To find a missing angle, take the others away from three hundred sixty.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Three angles are sixty five, ninety five and one hundred twenty five degrees. Find the fourth.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the field; two lines: the four angles of a quadrilateral add up to 360°; the missing angle is 360 minus the others; then a new quadrilateral with 65°, 95°, 125° and an empty box
